step1_figure.circuit_type: CS amplifier with current source load (modified to push-pull)
step1_figure.description: The netlist corresponds to the CS amplifier in Fig 21.21, utilizing a large feedback resistor for self-biasing the NMOS and a large coupling capacitor for the input. However, the netlist also includes an AC coupling capacitor to the PMOS gate, effectively making it a push-pull amplifier rather than a strict current-source loaded CS amp.

low_frequency_gain.description: Open-loop low-frequency voltage gain of the amplifier.

equation.explanation: Gain is the product of the transconductance of the input device and the total output resistance.
equation.assumptions: Assumes no external load resistor (Rload=infinity). Note that the netlist includes a 1kΩ Rload which will drastically reduce this theoretical gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assume ID=10uA, W/L=5 for NMOS. gm1 = sqrt(2 * 270uA/V^2 * 5 * 10uA) = 164 uA/V. ro1 = 1/(0.1*10uA) = 1 MΩ. ro2 = 1 MΩ. ro1 || ro2 = 500 kΩ. |Av| = 164uA/V * 500kΩ = 82 V/V (38.3 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the exact bias current and channel length modulation parameter (lambda) of the SKY130 devices.

input_capacitance.description: Effective input capacitance including Miller effect.

equation.explanation: The gate-drain capacitance is multiplied by the Miller effect.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assume Cgs1 = 23.3 fF, Cgd1 = 2 fF, |Av| = 82. Cin = 23.3fF + 2fF*(1 + 82) = 189 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on device sizing and achieved voltage gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assume Cdg2 = 6 fF, Cgd1 = 2 fF. Cout = 6fF + 2fF*(1 + 1/82) ≈ 8 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by parasitic drain-gate and drain-bulk capacitances of the devices.

dominant_pole.description: The lowest frequency pole of the amplifier.

equation.explanation: Pole associated with the output node when source resistance is zero.
equation.assumptions: Assumes Rs = 0 and no explicit compensation capacitor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on parasitic capacitances and output resistance.

equation.explanation: Zero caused by feedforward path through Cgd1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High frequency due to small parasitic Cgd1.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient response of the amplifier.
